title: NeonDeco x Japanese
description: A Resourcepack for NeonDeco to replace some of the Symboles with Japanese Letters. Mainly for building Cyberpunk styled Cities.
body:
You want to build a Cyberpunk themed City?
And need vanilla styled neon letters?

This is the one and only pack, you'll need!

A Resourcepack for NeonDeco to replace some of the Symboles with Japanese Letters.

**Dependencies**
NeonDeco: https://modrinth.com/mod/neondeco
